data.description: 330 Riverside Crescent | Waterfront Luxury by Sobha
data.display_address: 330 Riverside Crescent, Sobha Hartland II, Bukadra, Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present 330 Riverside Crescent, a stunning new residential development by Sobha Realty, located in the heart of Sobha Hartland II. Offering a blend of luxury, tranquility, and modern design, this tower is part of a master-planned community surrounded by nature and waterfront views.

Project Highlights:

Premium 1-, 1.5-, and 2-bedroom apartments
Located in the prestigious Sobha Hartland II, near Ras Al Khor
Direct views of the lagoon, parklands, and Downtown Dubai skyline
Elegant tower design with a unique crescent shape for panoramic vistas
Interiors featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, high-end finishes, and spacious layouts

World-Class Amenities:

Infinity-edge swimming pools & sky gardens
Indoor and outdoor gyms
Paddle courts, yoga decks & jogging trails
Retail promenade & fine dining options within the community
Dedicated children’s play zones and landscaped green spaces
24/7 security, concierge, and smart building features

Prime Location:

10 minutes to Downtown Dubai & Dubai Mall
Easy access to Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary and major highways
Close to top schools, healthcare facilities, and business hubs

330 Riverside Crescent is designed for those who seek peace by the water without giving up city convenience. Whether you’re an investor or a homebuyer, this development offers the perfect balance of luxury, location, and lifestyle.
